q: Weyl's equidistribution theorem states that the sequence {nα} (fractional parts) is equidistributed modulo 1 if and only if:
exp: Weyl's theorem: {nα} is equidistributed mod 1 (Cesàro averages of f({nα}) converge to ∫₀¹ f) iff α is irrational. This is equivalent to the ergodicity of the irrational rotation T_α: x ↦ x + α (mod 1).
